title: Every per-species AP was attributed to the wrong weed and overall mAP looked fine
symptom: wbf_tta_eval.py's hardcoded CANONICAL_12 is in a different order than the alphabetical cwd12_sealed.yaml; class id 2 is Eclipta in the data and PalmerAmaranth in that list.
root_cause: Class names were held in the evaluation tool instead of read from the dataset yaml the training run recorded, so the evaluation and the run could disagree about what a class id means. Overall mAP averages over ids and is unaffected, which is why nothing looked wrong.
correction_made: Class names and holdout directories come from --data-yaml; the old list kept as _LEGACY_CANONICAL_12 with a warning when used. Pre-flighted on the login node: 1,977 images with 1,977 labels in the correct alphabetical order.
